intended_object: The group homomorphism from the period subgroup ℤ·p (written multiplicatively) to the deck transformation group of the quotient map 𝕜 → 𝕜/ℤp = AddCircle p, sending a to translation e ↦ e + a. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation, where it is the map later shown to be an isomorphism.
explanation: The body sends a to addRightZMultiples a, which is Homeomorph.addRight a. This is a deck transformation because (e+a)−e = a ∈ zmultiples p. The homomorphism laws come from addRightZMultiples_zero and addRightZMultiples_add (translations compose additively; 𝕜 is commutative, so the order does not matter). Multiplicative is the right device to make the additive subgroup the domain of a monoid hom into the multiplicative deck group. The setting (any topological additive commutative group 𝕜) is the one Mathlib uses for AddCircle. The construction is tied to the specific quotient by zmultiples p that defines AddCircle p, so it is not too narrow. Translation by any subgroup H would give deck transformations of G → G/H, but this definition is about the AddCircle covering specifically.
